regressions.what: The previous outlet had excessive foam but a continuous water surface, while the current foreground reads as a dark dirt track.
A new rectangular field of evenly spaced bright pebbles cuts across the right bank.

blockers.target: The lake opens directly into a fan of shallow water that reaches nearly both bottom corners.
blockers.current: The lake pinches into a narrow central flow flanked by wide expanses of exposed ground.
blockers.change: Widen the visibly wetted channel to roughly 85–90% of the bottom edge and carry water continuously from the lake around the central rocks.

blockers.where: A3–B4 left bank and E3–F4 right bank
blockers.target: A grass-topped cut bank projects from the left opposite a low, sloping crescent of gravel on the right.
blockers.current: Both shores are broad bare slopes with scattered boulders and isolated plant tufts.
blockers.change: Shape the left edge into a projecting sod lip with an exposed vertical face, slope the right gravel shelf into the water, and fill both upper banks with contiguous grass.

blockers.target: Three partly submerged rocks form a triangle with two large rear rocks and a smaller front-left rock.
blockers.current: One large central rock dominates while several small rocks are scattered across the banks and foreground.
blockers.change: Group three rocks within the wetted channel, with the medium rock immediately behind and left of the largest and the low front-left rock about half its width.

next.target: The lake carries broad olive reflections that give way to transparent amber-gray shallows and short white wakes.
next.current: The lake has dense blue flecks and the stream is dark with a foamy streak down its center.
next.change: Broaden lake reflections, expose the stony bed through shallow water, and concentrate foam at the upstream faces and trailing edges of rocks.

next.target: Pebbles vary in scale and overlap irregularly along the waterline.
next.current: Pebbles repeat in aligned rows across sharply bounded patches.
next.change: Break up the rows with varied stone sizes, rotations and spacing, blending gravel into soil and grass along irregular edges.

excluded: Sky, surrounding mountains and distant upland terrain are outside the outlet scope.
unverifiable: The still captures cannot establish water motion.
